dial.$description: Dials: the few numbers a whole system is derived from. Change one and every token derived from it follows on every platform; tokens marked fixed do not. Color seeds are not dials — they are palette declarations in tokens/systems/.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Seven numbers the whole system is derived from. To make everything larger, roomier, rounder, bolder or slower, change a dial in your layer file instead of editing the tokens derived from it.
rules: Set a dial with {"$value": …, "reason": "…"} in a layer; never in component code.
A color is not a dial: declare or re-seed a palette under "palettes".
Changing space.unit without size.unit can make controls too small for their padding; the build reports it.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product sets its overall text size once (readability, audience, brand).
One product decides how far headings stand apart from body text. Applied as an exponent on each text size coefficient, so 1 leaves the ramp unchanged.
One product turns overall spacing up or down (airy marketing pages, dense tools).
One product sets the scale of control heights, icon sizes and hit targets together.
One product decides how round it is, everywhere at once.
One product sets the weight of its borders, rings and focus indicators.
One product is quicker or calmer overall.
